headline: Broad spectrum SPF 50, PA++++ for every day
subhead: Light texture that spreads easily, with no white cast.
footnote: Labelled SPF 50, confirmed by an independent lab. Offer terms, price and dates to be supplied and sourced by the marketer.
layout_description: Square 1080x1080. Offer line as the large headline block top-left (marketer fills the bracketed terms), with the offer condition directly beneath it in readable size and the valid-till date under that. Product headline and subhead below the offer on the left. Real pack shot on the right 45%, resting on the top of a low block. CTA bottom-left; footnote along the bottom edge. No price shown until the marketer supplies a sourced one.
image_prompt: Square 1080x1080 background plate only. A minimal studio set of three low, smooth geometric blocks in off-white and pale warm grey, arranged on the right side at different heights, with a seamless off-white backdrop. Soft natural light from the left, gentle soft shadows, clinical and uncluttered, a quiet echo of a colourful promo set but in a restrained neutral palette. Keep the right 45% of the frame as clear, evenly lit empty space on top of the blocks, reserved for a photo composited later. Keep the left 50% calm and low-detail as empty space for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Kept: the offer-promo structure (big offer line, product on display blocks, Shop now CTA). Dropped: the competitor's bundle price, discount code and 'buy any 3' mechanic (offer terms are not on our product page, so left as [placeholders] for the marketer), the 'limited time / hurry' urgency and emoji (house rule: no urgency), the youthful-skin promise, and the multi-product set (single SKU here). The brief input did not include the page price, so no price is printed; the marketer should add a sourced, dated price if the offer needs one.

verdict.label: Ready for human review (limited check)
verdict.detail: No rule hits. The model layer did NOT run, so implied claims and overall tone were not assessed — the reviewer must read for those.
